description: This file defines the interface for managing Git worktrees, including structures, function declarations for retrieving, validating, repairing, and managing worktrees, as well as related operations.

classes.name: worktree
classes.description: Structure representing a Git worktree, including repository reference, path, ID, HEAD reference, lock and prune reasons, and status flags.

methods.name: get_worktrees
methods.description: Retrieve all worktrees, with the primary first.

methods.name: get_worktrees_without_reading_head
methods.description: Retrieve worktrees without reading HEAD, useful for inconsistent refdb states.

methods.name: submodule_uses_worktrees
methods.description: Check if submodules use worktrees at a given path.

methods.name: get_worktree_git_dir
methods.description: Get the git directory of a worktree.

methods.name: find_worktree
methods.description: Find a worktree by a user-supplied argument, such as pathname or shorthand.

methods.name: get_linked_worktree
methods.description: Retrieve a linked worktree by its ID.

methods.name: find_worktree_by_path
methods.description: Find a worktree by its filesystem path.

methods.name: is_main_worktree
methods.description: Determine if a worktree is the main one.

methods.name: worktree_lock_reason
methods.description: Get the reason why a worktree is locked.

methods.name: worktree_prune_reason
methods.description: Get the reason why a worktree should be pruned.

methods.name: should_prune_worktree
methods.description: Decide if a worktree should be pruned, providing reason and path.

methods.name: validate_worktree
methods.description: Check if a worktree is in good condition.

methods.name: update_worktree_location
methods.description: Update the filesystem location of a worktree.

methods.name: repair_worktrees
methods.description: Repair linked worktrees and handle corruptions.

methods.name: repair_worktrees_after_gitdir_move
methods.description: Repair worktrees after moving the git directory.

methods.name: repair_worktree_after_gitdir_move
methods.description: Repair a specific worktree after gitdir move.

methods.name: repair_worktree_at_path
methods.description: Repair administrative files of a worktree at a given path.

methods.name: free_worktree
methods.description: Free memory allocated for a worktree.

methods.name: free_worktrees
methods.description: Free memory for multiple worktrees.

methods.name: find_shared_symref
methods.description: Find a worktree sharing a symbolic ref.

methods.name: is_shared_symref
methods.description: Check if a symref points to a ref in a worktree.

methods.name: other_head_refs
methods.description: Iterate over HEAD refs in all worktrees except one.

methods.name: is_worktree_being_rebased
methods.description: Check if a worktree is being rebased.

methods.name: is_worktree_being_bisected
methods.description: Check if a worktree is being bisected.

methods.name: strbuf_worktree_ref
methods.description: Generate a refname for a worktree.

methods.name: init_worktree_config
methods.description: Initialize worktree configuration settings.

methods.name: write_worktree_linking_files
methods.description: Write linking files for a worktree to connect it with the repository.
